title: Kagamine Len — Gifts Give Form To Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Valentine's Day, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... Valentine's Day is all about showing appreciation for close acquaintances and the people you care about most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why you give chocolates to all your friends!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, it doesn't have to be chocolates. Anything is okay as long as it symbolizes your appreciation for whomever receives your gift♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Gifts for the people you care about most...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wish I could make something like Mizuki and the others...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, what if I asked the others...?
They might know of something that I can do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want to make some gifts...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
As much as I'd like to help you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
There's nothing here...
You can't make anything even if you really want to.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I tried asking Rin and the others, but they all gave me the same response...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, this song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Len.
You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
You also wish to make some gifts for Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, but... I'm not sure if I can.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I even asked the others about this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They all said that I can't because there's nothing here and I wouldn't be able to make anything if I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len...
Why don't we try thinking about this more together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What would you like to do for Mafuyu and the others on Valentine's Day?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I thought the idea of giving gifts to those who mean most to you is really nice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I always have a lot of fun whenever they come over to SEKAI because they have so much to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... I want to tell them, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Len...
I wish I could've helped you more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: N-No, it's okay. I'm sorry for dropping this on you so suddenly. Thanks for spending the time to think about this with me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We may not have found a solid answer, but I think I realized something important...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Something important?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I think I really like talking to others and hearing about how they feel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I never realized how warm things feel when you think about doing something for someone else.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku, I'm gonna keep thinking more about what I can do for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you ever think that you need any help, feel free to ask. I'll be more than happy to help...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I will! Thanks, Miku!
